compiled_state.title: CI polling loop with configurable cadence and max-wait timeout
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1 (full): polls CI at 30s cadence (configurable)
- DD2: each poll iteration fetches CI check conclusions in one parallel gh api call
- DD3: max-wait timeout (configurable, default 60 min); on timeout the loop fails with a clear error message and the PR URL

## Description
After auto-merge is queued (Task 3), enter a polling loop. Read configuration via `read-config.sh`:
- `merge.pr_poll_interval_seconds` (default 30)
- `merge.pr_max_wait_seconds` (default 3600)

Each poll iteration: ONE call to `gh pr checks "$PR_NUMBER" --json name,state,conclusion` (or equivalent `gh api repos/.../check-runs` if richer schema is needed). Decide:
- Any FAILURE/CANCELLED conclusion → exit 1 with "ERROR: required check failed for PR <url>"
- All SUCCESS AND `gh pr view --json state --jq .state` returns `MERGED` → break loop, success
- Else → `sleep $interval`, increment counter

Track `_start=$SECONDS`; if `(SECONDS - _start) >= max_wait` → exit 1 with "ERROR: max-wait exceeded (<N>s) — PR URL: <url>".

Add the following RED tests to `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh`:

Given/When/Then:
- **t_pr_poll_single_call_per_iteration**: Given a shim that records every gh invocation; When pr.sh polls 3 times before success; Then the shim argv log shows exactly 3 `pr checks` lines (one per iteration; no fan-out)
- **t_pr_poll_succeeds_on_merged_state**: Given shim returns SUCCESS+MERGED on iteration 2; When pr.sh polls; Then exit 0 after iteration 2
- **t_pr_poll_fails_on_check_failure**: Given shim returns FAILURE conclusion on iteration 1; When pr.sh polls; Then exit ≠ 0 with PR URL in stderr
- **t_pr_poll_timeout**: Given `merge.pr_max_wait_seconds=1` test override and shim that returns IN_PROGRESS forever; When pr.sh polls; Then exit ≠ 0 with "max-wait exceeded" and PR URL in stderr

Tests must run quickly: set `merge.pr_poll_interval_seconds=0` (or a near-zero value if 0 is not allowed) in test config so loops do not block.

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (modify — add polling loop)
- tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh (modify — add 4 polling tests)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] All polling tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "t_pr_poll_.*PASS" | wc -l | awk '$1 >= 4'
- [ ] Configurable interval is honored
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "t_pr_poll_single_call_per_iteration.*PASS"
- [ ] Tests run in under 30 seconds total (fast loops)
  Verify: timeout 30 bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
